statement: PKG-6 / D11 — research register of the official rules per right. Each condition cites the official page it was read on and the page's own « Vérifié le » date. NOTHING here is validated: no expert has reviewed these conditions or the reference cases, so the assessment never treats them as an authoritative rule (states stay non-authoritative until status EXPERT_VALIDATED with a named reviewer, a date and passing reference cases). Figures are revalued regularly: always re-read the page.

draftCheckStatement: draftCheck = a machine-readable reading of the cited condition, written by ADA engineering (not by an expert). It is executed ONLY by api/lib/rulesDraft.js for the expert review pack and its tests; no user-facing assessment uses it while the right is not EXPERT_VALIDATED. A condition without draftCheck cannot be read from the answers ADA collects and always stays UNKNOWN.
